checks.name: ui
checks.run: s=$(xcrun simctl list devices | grep -F 'Artemis Build (' | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}' | head -1); [ -n "$s" ] || { echo 'No Artemis Build Simulator'; exit 1; }; xcrun simctl boot "$s" 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl bootstatus "$s" >/dev/null && SIM=$s APPEARANCES=light Scripts/ui-tests.sh; r=$?; xcrun simctl shutdown $s 2>/dev/null; exit $r

checks.name: ui-dark
checks.run: s=$(xcrun simctl list devices | grep -F 'Artemis Build (' | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}' | head -1); [ -n "$s" ] || { echo 'No Artemis Build Simulator'; exit 1; }; xcrun simctl boot "$s" 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl bootstatus "$s" >/dev/null && SIM=$s APPEARANCES=dark Scripts/ui-tests.sh; r=$?; xcrun simctl shutdown $s 2>/dev/null; exit $r
